steps.rationale: a postal code parsed as an integer is categorical by meaning

downstream.model_family: a linear model would otherwise read distance between postal codes as meaning

steps.rationale: order_id is unique on every row and customer_id is a foreign key: a key determines every column and poisons every dependency measure

alternatives.when: if a downstream join needs the ids, keep them outside the feature set rather than in it

downstream.model_family: a tree would memorise an id
downstream.leakage: an id can encode collection order

steps.rationale: unit_price and qty are the quantities the business sets; total is the outcome

alternatives.when: if the total is the observed quantity at prediction time and the unit price is not

downstream.dimensionality: the cycle contributes two dimensions, not three
downstream.interpretability: the controllable quantities stay as inputs

steps.rationale: the postal code is the finest of the three and determines the other two

alternatives.when: if the model should generalise across postal codes within a region

downstream.model_family: one 5-level nominal instead of three collinear ones
downstream.dimensionality: one dimension for geography, not three
downstream.interpretability: the postal code is the finest available grain

steps.rationale: total, subtotal, city and region are the heads of active rules under the chosen orientations; keeping them beside their parents is exact collinearity

alternatives.when: if a downstream consumer needs the total as a displayed quantity rather than a feature

downstream.model_family: a linear model no longer sees exactly collinear columns; coefficients become identifiable
downstream.dimensionality: four fewer columns for no loss of information

steps.rationale: the single defensible candidate in the geometry layer

downstream.interpretability: the task is 'was this order late'

steps.rationale: late is defined as delivered_days > 7; keeping delivered_days would teach the model the definition instead of the phenomenon

downstream.leakage: this step is the leakage control; without it the task is trivial and useless
downstream.interpretability: what remains is what is known before delivery

steps.rationale: F5 — the rows are ordered in time; a random split would let the model see the future

alternatives.when: if the model will never predict forward and class balance in the test part matters more than temporal honesty

downstream.preprocessing: everything fitted after this point is fitted on train alone
downstream.leakage: a random split would leak the future through the seasonal structure
downstream.interpretability: the test score answers 'how would this have done on the last months'

steps.rationale: a raw timestamp is not a feature; the calendar parts are, and the cyclic pair keeps December next to January

alternatives.when: if a tree model is the only consumer, since it can split the integer month itself

downstream.preprocessing: the raw date stays for reference and is dropped by keep_columns downstream if a model cannot take it
downstream.model_family: a linear model needs the sin/cos pair; a tree does not
downstream.interpretability: month and weekday are readable; the sin/cos pair is not

steps.rationale: F2 — unit_price is bimodal, so its mean is a value almost no row has; the median and the interquartile range describe it without pretending it is unimodal

alternatives.when: if every numeric column turns out unimodal after all, standard scaling is the conventional choice and slightly cheaper to explain

downstream.preprocessing: the four numeric features are centred on their medians
downstream.model_family: a regularised linear model needs comparable scales; a tree is indifferent
downstream.leakage: the statistics are fitted on the train part alone
downstream.interpretability: values are read in interquartile ranges from the median

steps.rationale: five postal codes and four note kinds: one-hot is exact at this cardinality and keeps every level readable in the coefficients

alternatives.when: if the postal code grows to hundreds of levels, at which point one-hot becomes a sparse wall and target encoding — fitted out of fold — is the honest alternative

downstream.model_family: a linear model reads each level as its own coefficient
downstream.leakage: none — one-hot uses no label information
downstream.dimensionality: nine indicator columns replace two nominal ones
downstream.interpretability: each level keeps its name in the column name
